text.en: This Notification may be cited as the Miscellaneous Offences (Pound Fees) Notification. [S 59/2021] Fees

The fees specified in the Schedule shall be payable in respect of animals impounded in public pounds under the provisions of section 27(1).

SCHEDULE (paragraph 2)

POUND FEES

For each head of poultry  $1 per day.

FEEDING CHARGES
